name: Giant Connect Four
description: Bring oversized fun to your event with our Giant Connect Four game! This larger-than-life version of the classic game is perfect for players of all ages. Guests take turns dropping colorful discs into the frame, aiming to connect four in a row while blocking their opponent's moves. Ideal for weddings, parties, or corporate events, this game guarantees hours of entertainment and adds a playful touch to any celebration.

name: Kids' Connect-Four
description: Get 3 times the fun in one game with this exciting combo of Connect Four , Ring Toss , and Basketball Toss ! This giant version of Connect Four takes the classic strategy game to the next level, but with a twist—it also includes ring toss and basketball toss elements, making it the ultimate multi-game experience. Players race to line up four pieces while also aiming for rings and shooting hoops for extra points, all within the same game.

name: Ladder Ball
description: This crowd-favorite lawn game invites players to toss bolas onto the ladder's rungs, with each rung earning different points. A perfect blend of skill and fun, Ladder Ball adds a competitive twist to any outdoor event. The first to reach the score limit wins!

name: Yard Pong
description: Take your event to the next level with our Yard Pong game set! Perfect for outdoor fun, this oversized version of the classic party game is sure to get everyone involved. Teams take turns tossing large ping pong balls into oversized cups, aiming to clear the other team’s cups first. Yard Pong is a fun, competitive game that’s perfect for parties, barbecues, weddings, or any outdoor celebration. Get ready for laughs, challenges, and great memories with this exciting game!

name: Football Player Toss
description: Feel like a pro quarterback with the Football Player Toss! Guests will have a blast aiming footballs through cut-out targets on this themed stand. Whether you're hosting a sports-themed event or just want to add a bit of competitive fun, this game is sure to be a hit.

name: Football Endzone
description: Test your throwing skills with Football Endzone, where players aim to land footballs in target holes of varying sizes. Perfect for sports fans, this game brings friendly competition and excitement to your event as players see who can hit the most targets.

name: Axe Throwing
description: Unleash your inner lumberjack with our Axe Throwing Rental ! This thrilling activity is perfect for adding some friendly competition and excitement to your event. Players take turns throwing lightweight axes at a target, aiming for the bullseye or the highest score. With a bit of skill and a lot of fun, it’s an unforgettable experience for guests at weddings , stag and does , corporate events , birthday parties , and more!

name: Spin-the-Wheel
description: Bring the thrill of a game show to your party with Spin-the-Wheel! Guests take a spin to win prizes, complete challenges, or try their luck. This game is great for adding a bit of excitement and surprise, with endless customization options for what each spin reveals.

name: Dropster (Plinko)
description: Add a touch of excitement to your event with our Dropster game! Similar to the classic Plinko, this interactive game features customizable panels, making it perfect for corporate branding, stag and doe fundraisers, or any event where fun meets strategy. Guests drop tokens from the top and watch them bounce through pegs to land in prize slots below. Create unforgettable moments with this eye-catching game that’s as entertaining to watch as it is to play. A guaranteed crowd-pleaser for any occasion!

name: Putting Golf
description: Bring the green to your event with this Putting Golf game! Whether players are seasoned golfers or just having fun, they’ll enjoy testing their putting skills. This compact game is easy to set up and offers a relaxing yet engaging activity for guests to enjoy.

name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: A larger-than-life take on a classic favourite! Our oversized Tic Tac Toe lawn game brings instant fun and friendly competition to any wedding, corporate event, or outdoor celebration. Perfect for guests of all ages, this interactive game is a great way to keep people mingling during cocktail hour or while enjoying the outdoors. Simple to play, quick to set up, and always a crowd-pleaser, it adds a playful touch without taking away from the elegance of your event. Whether your vibe is relaxed, stylish, or somewhere in between, Tic Tac Toe is a fun and engaging way to elevate your guest experience.

name: Ring Toss
description: Simple yet entertaining, the Ring Toss game adds a touch of classic carnival fun to any event. Players throw rings in an attempt to land them on posts for points. It's a great game for guests of all ages, offering a mix of challenge and enjoyment that can be played over and over.

name: Yardzee
description: Yardzee is a giant outdoor version of the traditional dice game, where players roll big wooden dice to complete various scoring combinations. With five rounds of rolling, players strategize to get the highest score. Perfect for both competitive groups and casual players, Yardzee is a hit for outdoor fun.

name: Giant Jenga
description: A giant version of the well-loved block-stacking game, Giant Jenga brings suspense and excitement to any gathering. As players remove blocks and place them on top of an increasingly unstable tower, the tension builds. Who will be the one to make it fall? Fun for all ages, this game never gets old.

name: Croquet
description: Add a touch of elegance to your event with Croquet, a classic lawn game where players use mallets to hit balls through a series of hoops. Whether your guests are experienced players or newcomers, Croquet provides a relaxing yet competitive game for outdoor gatherings.

name: Wedding Corn Hole
description: Cornhole is a classic lawn game where players toss bean bags onto a slanted board with a hole, aiming to get them through the hole or land on the board for points. With simple rules and competitive gameplay, Cornhole is a fan favorite at weddings , stag and does , showers , engagement parties , and more! This version of the game adds a twist to the traditional lawn game, making it a fun and unique addition to your celebration. Whether you’re creating friendly competition at your reception or adding a playful touch to your pre-wedding festivities, Wedding Cornhole is sure to bring excitement to the event. Ask us about our customization options!

name: Standard Corn Hole
description: Bring classic backyard fun to your event with our Cornhole game set! This easy-to-learn, highly addictive game is perfect for all ages. Players take turns tossing bean bags onto a wooden board with a hole at the end, aiming to score points by landing their bags in the hole or on the board. Whether you're hosting a casual family gathering or a lively event, Cornhole adds a fun, competitive element that will have everyone cheering. It's ideal for outdoor events, weddings, picnics, and more! Ask us about our customization options!

name: Ping Pong (Table Tennis)
description: Bring the fun (and a little friendly competition) to your big day or event with our Ping Pong Table rental ! Perfect for keeping guests entertained between ceremony and reception, or for adding that unexpected twist to your cocktail hour, this table is a total crowd-pleaser. Whether you're hosting a wedding, corporate event, backyard bash, or something in between, our ping pong table is ready to rally. It comes with paddles, balls, and all the good vibes you need for a smash hit. Bonus: it's easy to move, fits in all kinds of spaces, and sets up in no time. Who says weddings can’t have a little spin ?

name: Game Customization Add-On
description: Take your event to the next level with our Game Customization add-on. Whether you're planning a wedding, corporate event, or milestone celebration, this is a fun and stylish way to make your rentals truly one-of-a-kind. Popular Customizations Include: Couple’s initials or wedding monograms Company logos or event branding Custom messages or event hashtags Available on select games. Pricing varies depending on the design and game selected.

We offer three curated options — from simple elevated setups to fully custom luxury designs tailored to your event vision. Starting at $450 CAD

description: Make memories last with our Audio Guestbook Rental , available in Retro , Public , and Vintage styles, perfect for celebrating life’s special moments! Cherished Keepsake : All messages are saved and delivered on a USB drive after the event, so you can relive the love and laughter anytime. name: Mirror Disco Balls
description: Keep the energy high and the dance floor sparkling with our dazzling disco ball, the perfect addition to your wedding or event. With its 20-inch size and hundreds of reflective mini mirrors, it creates brilliant reflections that light up every inch of the dance floor. Shine colored lights towards the mirror ball for a spectacular mix of vibrant, moving spots that will fill the room with excitement and fun, ensuring your celebration is unforgettable.

name: Champagne Tower
description: Elevate your wedding or special occasion with our elegant champagne tower rental. Perfect for creating a show-stopping centerpiece, this tower offers a sophisticated, mess-free alternative to traditional glass coupe towers, making it safe and easy for your guests to enjoy.
